name: @nube/starter-theme-tokens
description: Pure-data source-of-truth for starter platform design tokens (palettes, density, radius, type, motion, semantic roles). Consumed by both web (@nube/starter-ui-kit, @nube/starter-ui-core/theme-editor) and mobile (@nube/starter-ui-kit-native). Zero runtime deps: no React, no React Native, no DOM, no styling runtime.
